description: Implement the five data pages: Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings. These pages are independent of FEAT-003 (Dashboard map/charts) but depend on FEAT-001 (auth store, api client, i18n, components exist). Each page fetches from the api-gateway endpoints where they exist and falls back to mock data (commented // MOCK DATA) where they don't.
steps: Step 1 — Implement src/pages/Fleet.tsx. State: vehicles array + selectedVehicle (for edit modal) + showAddForm. Fetch: GET /api/v1/drivers with fallback to mock fleet data (// MOCK DATA): 5 vehicles each with {id, plate, type:'car'|'bajaji'|'boda', driver_name, mileage, last_maintenance, status:'active'|'maintenance'|'offline'}. Render: page header with t('fleet_title'), Add Vehicle button. Vehicle list as a responsive table: columns plate, type, driver, mileage, last_maintenance, status badge (green/yellow/red), Edit button. Edit modal (overlay): form fields for plate, type (select), driver_name, mileage — Save calls PATCH /api/v1/drivers/vehicle/:id (mock if no operator-specific endpoint). Add Vehicle form: same fields, POST /api/v1/drivers/vehicle (mock). Use AlertBadge component (from step below) for status. All labels via t(). Style: white card table, same pattern as driver-dashboard Dashboard stat grid. VehicleCard component is not needed — inline table rows are sufficient.

Step 2 — Implement src/pages/Drivers.tsx. Fetch: GET /api/v1/drivers — the admin route at /admin/drivers returns drivers with name, phone, plate_number, total_trips, rating, status. If that 403s for operator token, fall back to // MOCK DATA array of 6 drivers: {id, name, phone, rating, trips_count, earnings_month, status:'online'|'offline'|'on-trip', vehicle_plate}. Render: page header with t('drivers_title'). Stats row: total drivers, online count, avg rating (StatCard components). Driver list table: name, phone, status badge, trips, rating stars, earnings, vehicle plate, Assign/Unassign button. Assign button opens a simple modal with a select of available vehicles (mock). All labels via t(). Clicking a row expands an inline details row (no separate page needed).

Step 3 — Implement src/pages/Earnings.tsx. Fetch: GET /api/v1/earnings/summary and GET /api/v1/earnings/history?limit=30. Both routes exist in api-gateway/src/routes/earnings.ts. On error fall back to // MOCK DATA. Render: period selector tabs (Today / Week / Month / All-time) — switching tab re-fetches with query params. Top stat cards: gross revenue, Safiri Haraka commission (gross * 0.15 // MOCK DATA commission rate), operator payout (gross - commission). Commission breakdown section: a simple table with columns — type, gross, fee (15%), payout. Payout history table: date, trips_count, gross, commission, net — last 10 rows from history. CSV Export button: builds CSV from history data and triggers download via anchor tag with data URI. All labels via t().

Step 4 — Implement src/pages/Reports.tsx. All data is mock (// MOCK DATA) since no operator-specific analytics endpoint exists. Render four sections: (1) Trip volume chart — BarChart (Recharts) with X=day labels (last 30 days), Y=trip count. (2) Top performing drivers table — 5 rows: driver name, trips, rating, revenue — sorted by trips desc. (3) Vehicle utilization — BarChart with each vehicle plate on X, utilization % on Y (trips_per_vehicle / max * 100). (4) Revenue per vehicle — horizontal BarChart. Period selector (Day / Week / Month) at top changes mock data labels. All labels via t(). Import { BarChart, Bar, XAxis, YAxis, CartesianGrid, Tooltip, Legend, ResponsiveContainer } from 'recharts'.

Step 5 — Implement src/pages/Settings.tsx. Sections: (1) Fleet Info — form inputs for fleet_name, contact_email, contact_phone. Pre-fill from useAuthStore().operator. Save calls PATCH /api/v1/auth/me (mock on error). (2) Commission Rate — read-only display showing the operator's commission rate (mock 15%) with a note that rates are set by Safiri Haraka admin. (3) Notifications — toggle switches for: trip_alerts, daily_summary, payment_notifications, system_updates. State in useState. (4) Language — select EN/Swahili; on change calls i18n.changeLanguage(val). Pattern from driver-dashboard/src/pages/Settings.tsx Toggle component. (5) Account — Logout button calling useAuthStore().logout(). All labels via t().

Step 6 — Create src/components/AlertBadge.tsx. Props: { status: string }. Maps status string to color: 'active'|'online'|'on-trip' → green, 'maintenance'|'offline' → yellow/red, default → gray. Renders a small <span> badge with rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold. Used by Fleet and Drivers pages.

Step 7 — Create src/components/VehicleCard.tsx (minimal, for future extensibility). Props: { plate: string; type: string; status: string; driver: string }. Renders a compact white card. Not used by table pages but satisfies the file structure requirement.
Step 8 — Create src/components/DriverCard.tsx (minimal). Props: { name: string; status: string; rating: number; trips: number }. Compact white card. Satisfies file structure.

Step 9 — Update the stub pages in src/pages/ — ensure Dashboard.tsx and Login.tsx stubs from FEAT-001 are NOT touched (Dashboard will be implemented in FEAT-003; Login was fully implemented in FEAT-001).
acceptance_criteria: npm run build exits 0 after this feature (all 5 pages import cleanly)
Fleet.tsx renders a vehicle table with mock data and edit/add forms
Drivers.tsx renders driver table with assign button
Earnings.tsx shows stat cards + payout history + CSV export button that generates a download
Reports.tsx renders 4 Recharts charts with mock data
Settings.tsx has all 5 sections including working language toggle (i18n.changeLanguage)
AlertBadge, VehicleCard, DriverCard components exist and compile

findings: All 5 pages (Fleet, Drivers, Earnings, Reports, Settings) fully implemented with mock data fallbacks. StatCard created in operator-dashboard/components (not imported from driver-dashboard). AlertBadge, VehicleCard, DriverCard components created. Reports uses all 4 Recharts chart types including horizontal BarChart for revenue-per-vehicle. Settings implements i18n.changeLanguage on language select. CSV export works via data URI anchor. npm run build exits 0, npm test exits 0 (passWithNoTests). Dashboard.tsx and Login.tsx stubs untouched.
